purpose: Test whether the predeclared independent AusTraits transport contains enough family x trait support for the same temporal/spatial trait-turnover design as BIEN, before any raw trait value or biological response is returned.

record_filter.value_use: presence predicate only; value is never selected, persisted, summarized, or inspected
record_filter.duplicate_rule: within family x trait x species, one structural measurement record is one distinct observation_id
record_filter.context_rule: do not filter basis_of_record/entity_type/value_type by observed support; source-context semantics are adjudicated in a separate pre-outcome gate after structural support
record_filter.rationale: This makes structural support an upper bound while preventing row duplication in the flattened serialization from inflating measurement counts.

joint_gate.family_count_rule: A family contributes at most one independent cluster even if multiple traits pass.

allowed_outputs: aggregate numbers of systems and independent families
next_gate_if_pass: Freeze AusTraits trait semantics/source-context rules, phylogeny crosswalk, and observed-geometry informativeness before any real trait state or turnover effect is opened.
next_gate_if_hold: Do not lower the matched BIEN thresholds. Record the independent transport HOLD; do not add a third primary trait source unless the pre-frozen finite-family rule is amended before biological outcomes.
